Riot mode: ACTIVATED. 🔥🤘 Revolutionary Riot Productions is turning Azucar's Main Floor into a straight-up war zone this Sunday, and the lineup is stacked. Oregon nu-metal beasts Rotting In Place headline the chaos, Yakima deathcore beatdown slam FTS is bringing the pit, Cosmic Accident brings that raw Yakima punk energy, and Tri Cities' own Babies Are Narcissists close it out local and loud. Four bands, one floor, zero chill. This is a mosh-at-your-own-risk situation — bring your neck, bring your lungs, leave the attitude of "I'll just watch" at home because you WILL get pulled in. All ages till 10:30, so bring the little riot starters early if you got 'em. Doors open at 4, first band hits at 5 sharp. Don't sleep on this one. 🖤💀

📅 Sunday, October 11 — Doors 4PM, Show 5PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10 cover
🔞 All ages till 10:30PM
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #MoshNight #RevolutionaryRiotProductions #PascoPunk #TriCitiesMetal #LiveMusicPasco #DeathcoreNight

You feel it before you hear it — floor vibrating, chests thumping, sweat already forming before the first chord even drops. 🔊🖤 Guitars screaming, blast beats rattling your ribs, a wall of bodies moving like one angry organism. Skulls and fangs painted across the flyer, neon pink and toxic green bleeding into black and white — that's the exact energy waiting on Azucar's Main Floor. Oregon nu-metal, Yakima deathcore slam, raw punk snarl, Tri Cities grit — it all collides into one sweaty, chaotic, beautiful mess. The kind of night where your ears ring for two days and you wouldn't trade it for anything. Elbows up, throat raw, heart pounding — that's the whole point. 🩸🎸

📅 Sunday, October 11 — Doors 4PM, Show 5PM

🔞 All ages till 10:30PM
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #MoshNight #PascoPunk #DeathcoreSlam #LiveMusicPasco #FeelTheBass #RiotVibes

No dress code for chaos. 🤘🖤 Doesn't matter if you're scene, punk, metalhead, or just curious what all the screaming's about — Azucar's Main Floor is wide open this Sunday for everyone who wants in on the riot. Come as you are, mosh how you want, sing along or just vibe from the back — this floor makes room for all of it. Rotting In Place, FTS, Cosmic Accident, and Babies Are Narcissists are bringing four totally different flavors of loud, so there's a pit for everybody. This is community built on noise — strangers turning into a crowd turning into a family by the last song. All ages welcome till 10:30, so bring your people, bring your energy, just don't bring an attitude problem. Everyone's equal once the pit opens. 💥🎤

Mark it down: Sunday, October 11 — Mosh Night takes over Azucar's Main Floor. 🗓️🎸 Doors open at 4PM, show kicks off at 5PM sharp. On the bill: Rotting In Place (Oregon nu-metal), FTS (Yakima deathcore beatdown slam), Cosmic Accident (Yakima punk), and Babies Are Narcissists (Tri Cities punk) — four acts, one relentless night courtesy of Revolutionary Riot Productions. Cover is $10, all ages welcome till 10:30PM. Fair warning straight from the flyer: mosh at your own risk. ⚠️ This is a full-on live band takeover, so get there early if you want a spot up front — floor space goes fast once the first set starts. Bring your neck, your lungs, and zero chill. 🤘
